provenance.source: NYC Parks & Recreation, Forestry Tree Points (NYC Open Data, Socrata dataset hn5i-inap)
provenance.query: All records with location inside lat 40.7385..40.7440, lng -73.9925..-73.9860 (around Madison Square Park / Flatiron Building), retrieved via the Socrata JSON API
provenance.trimmed: Only tpstructure = Full (standing trees); fields kept: objectid, lat, lng, dbh (inches), condition, species. Retired points and stumps dropped.
